clue.text: Reading between the lines?

parts.note: not interpreting a text but measuring the fixed distance between two railway rails

explanation.definitionFit: The usual railway track width is the measurement taken between the two rails, the 'lines' of a railway.

clue.text: Workforce getting hints about officials

indicators.note: about says the hints are wrapped around the workforce

parts.note: tips are hints or pieces of advice
the staff are the workforce of an organisation

explanation.surface: Employees are handed suggestions concerning the people in charge.
explanation.definitionFit: Tipstaffs are court officers who carry a staff of office, so they are officials.

clue.text: Smart being a non drinker in New York

indicators.note: in says the piece about a teetotaller sits inside the city's letters

parts.note: TT stands for teetotal, a person who drinks no alcohol

explanation.surface: Someone stays stylish by keeping off the booze in Manhattan.
explanation.definitionFit: Natty and smart both describe someone neatly and stylishly dressed.

clue.text: Flyer, one going by way of a rise

parts.note: A is one, as the indefinite article
via means by way of
a tor is a rocky hill, a rise in the land

explanation.surface: A pilot travels along a route that climbs uphill.
explanation.definitionFit: An aviator is a pilot, someone who flies aircraft.

clue.text: Feared doctor initially expected dead characters?

indicators.note: initially takes just the opening letter of the word expected
the letters, or characters, of the word dead are rearranged; the question mark flags the loose signal

parts.note: the letters of dead are used as written

explanation.surface: A patient was frightened when the doctor predicted that some people would die.
explanation.walkthrough: 'characters?' asks for the letters of DEAD jumbled, giving ADED to follow DR and E.
explanation.definitionFit: Something dreaded is feared in advance, a synonym in the past participle.

clue.text: A quiet friend finds Heather dreadful

parts.note: P is piano, the musical term for quiet
a pal is a friend
ling is a name for common heather

explanation.surface: Someone discovers that a quiet friend thinks a woman called Heather is awful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heather' looks like a woman's name, but it is the plant, also called ling.
explanation.definitionFit: Appalling and dreadful are synonyms meaning shockingly bad.

clue.text: A cur running round university backs to get cheese

indicators.note: backs says the whole assembled string is then read from end to start
running round puts the dog's letters around the university letter

parts.note: a cur is a dog

explanation.surface: A stray mongrel dashes about the campus and reverses to grab some cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'running round' puts U inside DOG to make DUOG; with A in front that is ADUOG, which 'backs' turns round.
explanation.definitionFit: Gouda is a mild Dutch cheese named after its home town.

clue.text: Drills hole with awl giving rise to threat of retribution

indicators.note: giving rise to says these letters are made into something new

explanation.surface: A handyman bores a hole with an awl, and somebody angrily promises punishment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'giving rise to' signals the anagram of DRILLS, HOLE and AWL; 'with' joins them.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom warns that people will be punished, by figurative execution, for what went wrong.

clue.text: Destroyed that which contains energy — a breakfast food

parts.note: shredded means torn to pieces, destroyed

indicators.note: contains says the energy symbol goes inside the word for that which

parts.note: what means that which, as in 'what I said'
E is the symbol for energy in physics

explanation.surface: Something ruined holds energy, and it turns out to be a breakfast cereal.
explanation.definitionFit: Shredded wheat is a cereal of pressed wheat strands eaten in the morning.

clue.text: Have feeling for poor shipmate going to Spain

indicators.note: poor suggests the shipmate is in a bad state, so the letters are mangled

parts.note: E is the international vehicle code for Spain (España)

explanation.surface: A sailor sympathises with a hard-up crewmate heading for Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: To empathise is to share and understand another person's feelings.

clue.text: Tobacco user's accessory initially producing pained expression

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letter of the word producing

parts.note: ouch is what people say when hurt

explanation.surface: A smoker's kit at first makes someone wince.
explanation.definitionFit: A tobacco pouch is a small bag pipe smokers carry their tobacco in.

clue.text: Unbalanced party, oddly tatty

parts.note: a do is a party

indicators.note: oddly takes the first, third and fifth letters of the word tatty

explanation.surface: A celebration that is slightly mad and somewhat shabby.
explanation.definitionFit: Dotty means mildly mad, mentally unbalanced.

clue.text: View data left after damage from tsunami?

indicators.note: after damage says the letters are now in a broken, reordered state

explanation.surface: A scientist looks over figures recorded once a disaster has struck.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the definition as loose: a tsunami is commonly but loosely called a tidal wave.
explanation.definitionFit: A tsunami is a huge sea wave, popularly known by this name though tides are not its cause.

clue.text: One talks vaguely, reflecting on regulation, getting very loud

indicators.note: reflecting says the whole string is mirrored, read from the end back

parts.note: RE means on or concerning, as in business letters

indicators.note: getting says the law takes in the musical very loud mark

parts.note: a law is a regulation
FF is fortissimo, the musical mark for very loud

explanation.surface: A speaker thinking aloud about rules suddenly starts shouting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting' puts FF inside LAW to give LFFAW; RE before it makes RELFFAW, which 'reflecting' turns round.
explanation.definitionFit: A waffler is a person who speaks at length without getting to the point.

clue.text: Air one's preference for a ringer

parts.note: an air is a look or manner, as in 'an air of confidence'
A is one, the indefinite article; the 's is a link
a like is a preference, as in 'likes and dislikes'

explanation.surface: Someone voices which bell they would rather hear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Air' looks like a verb, to voice, but it is the noun meaning appearance; 'ringer' is not a bell-ringer but a double.
explanation.definitionFit: A dead ringer is someone who looks exactly like another person, a double.

clue.text: Removed liquid round pianos, produced small amounts of water

indicators.note: round says the word for removed liquid surrounds the pianos

parts.note: dried means removed moisture or liquid
P is piano, so two make PP

explanation.surface: Someone wiped down the pianos, which had been leaking water.
explanation.definitionFit: Water that dripped fell in small drops, a little at a time.

clue.text: Having complicated repair done, mostly settle in advance

indicators.note: complicated says the letters are tangled into another order
mostly says the word done loses its last letter

explanation.surface: A tricky repair, nearly finished, lets someone sort things out beforehand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' cuts DONE to DON; 'complicated' scrambles REPAIR with DON.
explanation.definitionFit: To preordain is to decide or fix something beforehand.

clue.text: Moving soil's getting me supple

indicators.note: moving says the letters of soil's are shifted around

explanation.surface: Digging in the garden keeps me flexible.
explanation.definitionFit: Lissome means lithe and flexible, a synonym of supple.

clue.text: Gave good example, worshipped, putting head down

indicators.note: putting head down says the leading letter is moved lower in the word

parts.note: deified means made a god of, worshipped

explanation.surface: A devout person set a fine example by praying with bowed head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'putting head down' moves D, the first letter of DEIFIED, down one place.
explanation.definitionFit: To edify is to instruct and improve someone morally, as a good example does.

clue.text: leader should be intellectual

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held, 'leader should be intellectual', opens lower-case and lacks the word for EGG (as in egg on, urge): HEAD is leader, but nothing gives EGG; the clue looks cut short and no reprint was found.

clue.text: Make etching of English party

parts.note: a rave is a large lively party

explanation.surface: An artist produces a print of a celebration in England.
explanation.definitionFit: To engrave is to cut a design into a surface, as an etcher does.

clue.text: Calling after sheep that's running amok

indicators.note: after says the calling comes behind the sheep

parts.note: a ram is a male sheep
paging means calling someone, as over a tannoy

explanation.surface: A shepherd shouts after a sheep that has gone wild.
explanation.definitionFit: Rampaging means rushing about violently, out of control.

clue.text: Chinese chairman comes round about former colony

indicators.note: comes round says the chairman's name encloses the short word for about

parts.note: Mao Zedong was Chairman of the Chinese Communist Party
CA is circa, about

explanation.surface: The Chinese leader pays a visit concerning a territory once ruled from abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: Macao was a Portuguese colony until it returned to China in 1999.

clue.text: Some small urchins move unsteadily

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A few little street children stagger about.
explanation.definitionFit: To lurch is to stagger or sway suddenly, moving without balance.

clue.text: French city not altogether lovely on surface

indicators.note: not altogether says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A French town is only pretty from the outside.
explanation.definitionFit: Lyons is the English spelling of Lyon, a large city in France.

clue.text: One pound given to Greek character for eastern fruit

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for pound, from Latin libra
I is the Roman numeral for one
chi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A single coin is handed to a man from Greece in exchange for exotic fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: The lichi, or lychee, is a fruit native to China.

clue.text: Object of affection in Roma returned at one

indicators.note: returned says the word Roma is turned round

parts.note: A is one, the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A lover goes back to Rome to meet someone special.
explanation.definitionFit: An inamorata is a woman someone is in love with, a beloved.

clue.text: In which one's geared up to be the efficient businesswoman?

definitions.text: In which one's geared up to be the efficient businesswoman?

parts.words: In which one's geared up to be the efficient businesswoman?
parts.note: geared up means dressed in gear, clothes chosen to project authority at work

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names wearing smart, authoritative clothes to look influential in business.
